# Get involved

SEMinR is an open-source project, and its community is the best place to get
help, share your work, and shape where the package goes next.

* **Facebook group** — join the [SEMinR user community on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/groups/seminr) to ask questions, discuss PLS-SEM and CBSEM, and connect with the developers and other users.
* **Issue tracker** — report bugs or request features on the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/sem-in-r/seminr/issues).
* **Source code** — browse or contribute to the code on [GitHub](https://github.com/sem-in-r/seminr).
